scope: A separate continuation study after the primary experiment failed calibration. Existing primary results and candidates remain immutable.
objective: Both arms continue the same parent with the existing RLOO+CE and frozen-Foundation replay anchoring. The primitive arm adds mean BCE for the four A/B/C/D probabilities at the four existing dot positions; gradients reach late backbone LoRA. The shared auxiliary decoder is discarded before inference.
matched_design: Same parent, seed, shuffled group order, two epochs, decision loss, optimizer schedule and replay for both arms. Auxiliary initialization preserves CPU/CUDA RNG. Only the added auxiliary loss and decoder optimizer group differ. One training seed is a limitation; this is not a multi-seed robustness claim.
candidate_checkpoints: Parent plus epoch 1 and 2 from both arms; actual merged BF16 development inference for every candidate.
selection: Development only. Require the original retention/workflow/probability eligibility and maximum threshold coverage >=0.60 under expected error <=0.15 for each question type on development. Among eligible models use the original mean known/new workflow accuracy, then uncertainty NLL and cost at 80% coverage. If none qualify, no calibration/final evaluation.
data_policy: Training and candidate selection use original train/development groups only. Prior calibration rows are excluded. Before fitting a follow-up deployed policy, freeze fresh calibration groups of the same domains/family roles. Original independent final groups remain untouched; if any final prediction is later inspected, subsequent claims require fresh final groups.
publication: No release before every original mandatory gate passes for the exact selected weights, fresh calibration, independent final and real HTTP runtime.
